components.guide.faq1.a: .html, .htm and .zip files. Make sure ZIP files contain an index.html as the entry point.
components.guide.faq2.q: Is there a file size limit?
components.guide.faq2.a: Maximum 5MB per file or ZIP archive. Compress images to reduce size.
components.guide.faq3.q: How long do pages stay up?
components.guide.faq3.a: Anonymous uploads are auto-destroyed after 24 hours. Logged-in users get 5 permanent slots free. Members have unlimited storage.
components.guide.faq4.q: How do I get my page on the Square?
components.guide.faq4.a: Check "Share to Square" when uploading after logging in. Your page will be categorized and discoverable by everyone.
components.guide.faq5.a: All pages have a safety banner injected and Content-Security-Policy disables form submissions to prevent phishing.

components.guide.tip1.desc: Name your entry file index.html in ZIP uploads, put CSS/JS in subfolders

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using 100mini, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
terms.section1Body: 100mini provides a platform for uploading, hosting, and sharing static HTML content. The service is provided "as is" without any warranty.
terms.section2Body: You are solely responsible for the content you upload. You must not upload content that is illegal, abusive, defamatory, or infringes on the rights of others.
terms.section3Body: Anonymous uploads are automatically deleted after 24 hours. Registered users may have longer retention periods as specified in their account settings.
terms.section4Body: 100mini shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.
terms.section5Body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.section1Body: We collect information you provide (name, email) when you register, as well as content you upload. We also collect basic usage data such as page views and IP addresses.
privacy.section2Body: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, and ensure platform security. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.section3Body: We use essential cookies for authentication and security. Third-party cookies are not used for tracking purposes. For details, see our Cookie Policy.
privacy.section4Body: Your data is stored on Cloudflare's global network. Content uploaded anonymously is stored temporarily and automatically deleted after 24 hours.
privacy.section5Body: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at hello@100mini.com.
cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.heading: Cookie Policy
cookie.intro: This policy explains how 100mini uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookie.section1Body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website function properly and improve your experience.
cookie.section2Body: We use essential cookies for authentication (session management) and security. These cookies are necessary for the platform to function.
cookie.section3Body: We do not use third-party tracking cookies. Analytics data is collected anonymously and does not involve cookies.
cookie.section4Body: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of the platform.
cookie.section5Body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.
